statements.label: thm:r74-depolarizing-obstruction
statements.title: Exact memory in a uniformly positive one-dependent family
hypotheses: The three displayed qubit branches Psi0=Ad(Utheta)/8, Psi1=tr(EX)tau/4 and Psi2=D-Psi0-Psi1
sin(theta)!=0 and known initial state I/2
